Therefore, if `nick` is an empty string, the call to `charAt(0)` will result in an `IndexOutOfBoundsException` because the index 0 is not less than the length of the string, which is 0. The only exception that `charAt` can throw, `IndexOutOfBoundsException`, is not avoided by the current checks.
